annotations.title: Make a page permanent (spends a mint)

description: Make one page permanent with one mint: it never expires, loses the MintPage badge, gets Pro limits (2 MB, custom slug via update_page, indexable) and stops counting toward the live-page limit. Costs 1 mint from the account's balance, once per page; no charge if the page is already minted or the account is on Pro (already permanent). Mints come in a Peppermint pack (10 for $5, one-time, never expire) at https://mintpage.ai/billing. It spends a paid credit, so only call it when the user asked for the page to stay up. Requires an API key.

page_id.description: The page_id returned by publish_page or list_pages.
